name: lc-imported-services-vat
description: Saint Lucia VAT on services bought from abroad for 2026. Covers recipient liability under section 9(2)(c), who pays under section 28(3) (overseas businesses supplying a person or local branch, registered recipients using the service outside taxable supplies, and non-registered recipients below the threshold or not making taxable supplies), the local branch rule, the import declaration and payment within 21 calendar days after the tax period, the time of import (section 26) and the 12.5% rate. Trigger phrases include Saint Lucia imported services VAT, reverse charge Saint Lucia, foreign consultant VAT Saint Lucia.
